provenance.title: Launch HN: BitBoard (YC P25) – Analytics Workspace for Agents

facts.statement: BitBoard is an agentic analytics workspace that provides infrastructure and a visualization layer to analyze data with AI.
facts.value: agentic analytics workspace providing infrastructure and visualization to analyze data with AI

facts.statement: BitBoard enables users and their agents to work together on dashboards to analyze data and build live reporting.
facts.value: dashboard collaboration for data analysis and live reporting

facts.statement: BitBoard builds on recent advances in large language models to enable analysis and collaboration with AI agents on business data.
BitBoard describes itself as an analytics workspace designed for humans and AI agents to interact with shared data primitives and build dashboards collaboratively.
facts.value: analytics workspace for human and AI collaboration

facts.statement: BitBoard's launch was announced on Hacker News on 2026-06-12.
BitBoard offers a hosted service accessible at https://app.bitboard.work.
BitBoard accumulates data, queries, transforms, charts, and controls together at a shareable URL so teammates can inspect and rerun the analysis.
facts.value: data, queries, transforms, charts, controls stored in shareable URLs

facts.statement: Users can try BitBoard for free by signing up with an email at https://app.bitboard.work without requiring a credit card.
BitBoard offers flat-rate pricing plans publicly: free for individuals, $49 per seat per month for teams, and custom pricing for enterprises.
facts.value: flat-rate plans: free individual, $49/seat team, custom enterprise

facts.statement: Enterprise-level plans require contacting sales for custom proposals, but individuals and teams can start without a sales gate.
